CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a whip pan that resolves onto the subject on a 50mm normal, framing with leading lines converging on the subject from the lower corners.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a beauty dish above the lens axis with a silver reflector under the chin; grade as high-contrast teal-and-orange with protected mid-tone skin. Specify the sound design in one clause — what the viewer hears in the first second decides whether they stay.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.
